seededLessons.symptom: Contract violation: required key invoiceId missing; found similar key invoice_id in tool arguments.
seededLessons.fix: Always enforce camelCase parameter naming in tool calls: use invoiceId, not invoice_id.

seededLessons.symptom: Missing required currency field in extract_invoice tool arguments.
seededLessons.fix: Specify default currency USD when ambiguous in extraction prompt instructions.

seededLessons.symptom: Double-precision amount cast to string type causing downstream schema rejection.
seededLessons.fix: Explicitly cast extracted invoice total to numerical float double.

seededLessons.symptom: Line item tax calculation omitted in extraction summary step.
seededLessons.fix: Add verification step to cross-check subtotal plus tax before calling tool.

seededLessons.symptom: Vendor legal business entity name truncated at 32 characters by parser.
seededLessons.fix: Increase vendor string chunk buffer to preserve complete vendor names.

seededLessons.symptom: Date format ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD violated with UK format DD/MM/YYYY.
seededLessons.fix: Prompt rule: Dates must strictly follow ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

seededLessons.symptom: Payment terms net_30 missing from extracted tool call metadata.
seededLessons.fix: Extract paymentTerms whenever Net 30 or Due Upon Receipt appears in invoice body.

seededLessons.symptom: Duplicate invoice number generated when parsing credit memo invoices.
seededLessons.fix: Distinguish credit notes with prefix CR- to avoid unique key collisions.
